title: SMO module manifest (<module>/module.yaml)
description: What one module is to the rest of the SMO. scripts/modules.py validates every manifest against this schema, checks it against the module's own files, and generates from all of them the shared files that list modules (docker-compose.yml's module regions, the chart's modules, migrations/db_roles.json and table_owners.json, R1 Termination's routes.json, smo-mutation.yml's paths). Every key is required: a module that has no part in something says so (null, [], false).

name.description: The module's directory name (the last part of its path), which is also its suite, its coverage and its generated files' name.

lane.description: The lane that owns the module (CLAUDE.md, Working in parallel).

r1.description: R1 Termination's static routes to this module: a path prefix, the environment variable that overrides its address, and the default address. ProvMnS is not listed: it is routed by the MnS registry (r1-termination/app/mns_routing.py).

database.description: null: the module has no database. role: its login role smo_<name> (scripts/db_roles.py: its schema and the shared tables it may use), or null when it has none. tables: the tables it owns.

schema.description: its own schema, or null for a role that uses only shared tables (R1 Termination: the audit chain and the rate buckets)

read.description: other modules' tables it may read, as schema.table (R1 Termination: the kill switch)

openapi.description: Whether scripts/generate_openapi_specs.py writes docs/openapi/<name>.json from the module's app.

tests.description: The module's unit suite (scripts/run_unit_suite.sh): what coverage measures, the PYTHONPATH it runs with (relative to the module), and its coverage floor (scripts/coverage_floor.py). null: no Python unit suite.

mutation.description: The module's run in scripts/mutation_pilot.sh: its PYTHONPATH ($SMO is the absolute smo/ path), its targets (equal to its pyproject.toml's [tool.mutmut] only_mutate), and the paths (from the repository root) whose change runs smo-mutation.yml on a pull request. null: not mutation tested.

code_docs.description: Whether scripts/check_code_docs.py holds the module to a baseline file of its own (scripts/code_docs_baseline/<path with / written -->.json).

config_reference.description: Whether the module reads environment variables, documented in docs/configuration/<name>.md and .json (scripts/config_reference.py).

compose.description: The module's part of docker-compose.yml, as the YAML text of each top-level section (keys at column 0; it may use the file's anchors: *hardening, *ready_probe, *worker_probe, *build_info, *db_env, *wait_for_schema). null: not in compose.

helm.description: The module's entries under `modules:` in deploy/helm/smo/values.yaml, as YAML text (keys at column 0). null: not in the chart.
